findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Test
Case: normal use - Forge obtains failing test results from a pull request’s CI checks.
The named proof writes the expected failure directly into `state["tests"]`; it never runs close or supplies a failing GitHub check. In CI mode, `src/forge/close.py:259-262` removes that field and `src/forge/worker.py:561-574` obtains failures through a different path. Consequently, this test still passes when that path sends no failed test names, as it does for a failed job in an unfinished workflow. Exercise the close-to-repair flow with the review and GitHub services faked at their boundaries.
